description: Directory search. Use when a developer, tool maker, business or AI agent needs to find AI-agent tools (MCP servers, frameworks, browser automation, memory, evals, voice, coding agents and more) by keyword or category before choosing one, or wants MCP servers and pay-per-call services with how to connect and how to pay (filter by protocol mcp, x402 or mpp, or by payable or free). Free to call. Free without an API key over REST and MCP. Anonymous searches have per-IP limits of 30 calls per minute and, where the shared limiter is configured, 600 per hour; 429 responses include Retry-After. Keyed calls cost 0 credits and keep the key's existing limits.

capability.description: A tested capability token: mcp_server_card, ard_manifest, ai_catalog, a2a_agent_card, openapi, x402_discovery or llms_txt. Returns verified tools where PageVerified found it; no indexed entries.

category.description: One of the PageVerified directory category slugs.

limit.description: Maximum tools to return, applied separately to tools and indexed.

payment.description: payable (machine-payable via x402 or MPP) or free (the catalog says so). Returns indexed entries only.

protocol.description: mcp, x402 or mpp. Returns indexed entries only.

q.description: Keyword to search over the verified tools and the indexed catalog entries.

name: directory_search
